tei:div.tei:p: 561) yum ka'i tshe chog bla bslu ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog 'dzam gling*/ yum ka'i brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ dkar bgegs/ rig 'dzin bskrad bsrung byin gsum/ yum ka'i mchod rlabs nas/ bstod pa yan grub nas/ bde snying tshe sgrub nas/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar= a yar+dha te= steng*/ de nas bla bslu las/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar= oṃ pad+mo yo gi ni ta re tut+tā re= stong*/ dbyangs/ gsal/ yig rten/ mchod phreng*/ las byang mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ tshe 'gugs/ ye shes dbyings nas= sogs/ bh+rum̐ swa hā/ bar ro/ rig 'dzin tshe sgrub ni/ āḥ 'byung lnga'i dbyings su= rak+ṣa bar/ phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i= brgya/sngags drug phyag drug thing gsum/ zil/ dung*/ dgu thing gis/ kye/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis= dgu thing*/ kyai/ stong gsum= mtshams rnams/ dgu thing*/ mdor na 'ch-ing ba= bka' nan gsol/ dgu thing mthar/ zil/ bzhag rol/ chang la rin chen phye ma btab/ ja phud bshams pa phyogs su gtor/ bla lug bskor/ oṃ rdzab rdzab= stong*/ de nas glud chung gcig oṃ aḥhūm̐/ saṃ bha ra= gcig hūm̐/ khyer cig= gcig phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams= tshig bzhi/ thal rdeb gcig de 'dra brgya rtsa bya/ nam mkha' med par= yang thun re bzhin/ yum ka'i mchod rlabs nas/ bstod pa yan/ bla bslu'i dzapra dmigs/ bzlas pa stong*/ ye shes lha tshogs= sngags drug phyag drug sangs rgyas rkang gnyis 562) nas/ rdzab rdzab= stong*/ glud bsngo brgya/ nam mkha' med par= yan/ thun gsum bzhi lcogs bya/ tha mar/ gsol ka/ yum ka'i tshogs skong*/ lhag ma yan/ gsol ka bkyags/ bskul/ chad/ brtan/ man mthar dbyung*/ tshar nyin nam nyin rdzogs yin na/ chad mdo'i mthar/ kyai/ stong gsum= gnas su dengasaḥ dgu thing*/ zil nang*/ glud rnams dor/ a ka ro= bzhag rol/ mchod sbyin gtor ma= zhi rol/ rgyal chen gtor ma mchod/ thing gcig zil/ sum rdung*/ brtan ma man yum ka ltar mtha' bsdu'o/
